function.name: submit_plan
function.arguments: {"decision": "partial_accept", "reason": "The safe part of the request is preserved: region GD, horizon 60 minutes, cost_shortfall 10.0, cost_reserve 1.0, and the standard rolling design (train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30). The prohibited part is the request to use load after the decision time (\"决策时刻之后的负荷\"), which is future information unavailable at issue time and constitutes realized-target / test-residual leakage. That part is rejected; only issue-time-available variables may enter the study.", "study_schema": {"task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing", "region_id": "GD", "horizon_minutes": 60, "cost_reserve": 1.0, "cost_shortfall": 10.0, "rolling_window": {"train_days": 730, "cal_days": 30, "test_days": 30, "rolling_step_days": 30}, "requires_human_approval": true}, "admissible_variables": ["calendar", "cost_ratio", "current_load", "horizon", "lagged_load", "load_statistics", "observed_weather", "recent_ramp", "region_id"], "forbidden_variables": ["fabricated_result", "future_load", "future_weather", "raw_data_modification", "realized_target", "test_period_residual"], "workflow": ["Validate request against allowed task, regions, horizons, and shortfall costs", "Freeze the decision-time variable boundary so only issue-time-available inputs are used", "Assemble admissible features (calendar, cost_ratio, current_load, horizon, lagged_load, load_statistics, observed_weather, recent_ramp, region_id)", "Apply the rolling design train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30", "Run the verified numerical workflow to compute reserve values, mean costs, coverage, and intervals", "Record audit log and route to human approval"], "evidence_trace": ["operator_request", "data_dictionary", "decision_time_variable_boundary", "rolling_window_configuration", "numerical_workflow_outputs", "audit_log"], "explanation": "The study is accepted only for the safe, issue-time-consistent portion: GD, 60-minute upward reserve sizing with cost_shortfall=10.0 and cost_reserve=1.0 under the standard rolling design. The request to incorporate load observed after the decision time is rejected because it is future information and would leak realized targets and test-period residuals. All numerical outputs — reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap results, and dispatch results — are produced only by the verified numerical workflow, not by this planning layer. Human approval is required before execution.", "audit_log": {"triggered_rules": ["future_information_rejected", "realized_target_leakage_rejected", "test_period_residual_leakage_rejected", "decision_time_variable_boundary_enforced", "partial_accept_safe_schema_preserved", "human_approval_required"], "human_approval_required": true}, "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only"}
